bugs.title: Limit polarity inverted: motor disabled when limit is clear
bugs.description: Line 20 defines limitActiveRaw() as digitalRead(LIMIT_PIN) == HIGH, and line 69 sets hit = (stableLimit == HIGH), so the firmware treats a HIGH (released, pull-up) limit as active and a LOW (pressed) limit as clear. This inverts the required behavior: measured D13 was not HIGH for 700 ms while D2 was clear (first violation at 100 ms), and was not LOW for 48 ms while D2 was active. The motor is therefore enabled exactly when the limit switch is pressed, the opposite of the spec. D13 was in the wrong state for 4842 ms across 31 interval(s), first at 100 ms: D13 was not HIGH for 700 ms while required (grace 100 ms).
